pde_sec.text: the level of extracellular cAMP is controlled by a phosphodiesterase secreted by the cells

pde_bader.text: extracellular cAMP is degraded predominantly by DdPDE1 (PdsA) and DdPDE7

pde_null_g.text: pdsA- cells respond to a narrower range of cAMP and do not form streams at low density

pde_null_s.text: PDE-null cells cannot move in a coordinated manner in mounds

promoters.text: the pdsA gene has separate promoters for growth, aggregation and late development

pa_off.text: the aggregative PdsA promoter is down-regulated after aggregation

inhib_stoich.text: inhibitor and PDE interact with 1:1 stoichiometry

inhib_absent.text: the inhibitor is not produced during growth and appears after transfer to starvation buffer

inhib_reg.text: inhibitor synthesis is repressed by (pulses of) exogenous cAMP, regulated independently of the enzyme

pdsa_growth.text: pdsA is expressed during vegetative growth, aggregation and in prestalk cells

pdsa_er.text: the intracellular pool of PdsA is localised to the endoplasmic reticulum, a possible compartment for storage and secretion

pdsa_loc.text: PdsA can be secreted into the medium or exposed on the cell surface

complex_km.text: the inhibitor raises the Km of the phosphodiesterase (about 10 uM to 2 mM), i.e. the complex retains a strongly reduced activity
